products.title: The Potty Training Playbook + Night Night, Milo! (Ebook Bundle)
products.body_html:
Two brilliant.kids ebooks, together and free today.

The Potty Training Playbook
Simple, calm tips to make potty training easier and faster, for you and your little one. Inside: how to tell if your little one is ready, getting set up, a 7 Day Kickstart Plan, 12 tips to get there faster, handling accidents calmly, outings, naps and nights, what to do when things stall, and a progress chart to track every win.

Night Night, Milo!
A cozy illustrated bedtime story about Milo the little squirrel, made to read together at the end of the day.

  • Two digital ebooks (PDF)
  • Read on your phone, tablet or computer
  • Nothing to ship
